class Cell(ind: int, ring: Ring, resolution: float = None)

Bases: CellBase

Cell for voronoi-based decomposition.

Processes:

Find the minimum clearance of the cell based on critical points. Process the cell: - Removing points that are too close to critical points.

Parameters:

  • ind (int) -- Cell index.

  • ring (Ring) -- Rings (closed loops) containing critical points.

  • resolution (float) -- Map resolution (m/px).

covpp.segmentation.voronoi_segmentation.segmentation_voronoi module

Voronoi-based segmentation for optimal workspace decomposition.

class Segmentation(zmd: ZoneMapData, map_polygons: MapPolygons)

Bases: SegmentationBase

Voronoi diagram-based segmentation for workspace decomposition. Creates cells.

Uses Voronoi decomposition to partition the workspace into cells based on critical points, creating geometrically optimal regions for coverage.

Segmentation Pipeline:

  1. Voronoi decomposition of workspace

  2. Identify critical points and create rings

  3. Generate cells from rings

Result:

self.cells populated with Voronoi-derived Cell objects plus adjacency metadata; self.n_cells reflects the number of valid rings.

Parameters:

  • zmd (ZoneMapData) -- Zone map data object.

  • map_polygons (MapPolygons) -- Polygon representation of the workspace.

run() → None

Execute Voronoi-based decomposition and segmentation process.

main_segmentation(b_poly: Polygon, obs_polys: list[Polygon]) → None

Create segmentation rings from critical points.

Pipeline Steps:
  1. Preprocess:

    • Create polygon point start/end indices

    • Create critical point basis indices lists

    • Find skip critical points

  2. Rings:

    • Create all segments (rings) from critical points

create_cp_segment(i_cp: int, cp: CriticalPoint) → Ring

Create a segment (ring) for a critical point.

Method: - Start from one of the basis points of the critical point. - Traverse the Voronoi points along the polygon until reaching the other basis point. - Along the way, if another critical point is encountered, add it to the ring and

jump to its other basis point.

  • Continue until returning to the starting critical point.

covpp.segmentation.voronoi_segmentation.voronoi_decomposition module

Voronoi decomposition module.

class VoronoiDecomposition(zmd: ZoneMapData, map_polygs: MapPolygons)

Bases: object

Voronoi decomposition of the zone map.

Steps:

1- Process polygons to ensure suitability for Voronoi decomposition. (adding points if needed) 2- Find Voronoi diagram based on the bounding polygon and obstacle polygons. 3- Evaluate Voronoi vertices and create VPoint objects with features. 4- Find ridge Voronoi points and set related features. 5- Set basis points and feasibility for Voronoi points. 6- Find adjacent Voronoi points based on distance and minimum number of adjacents. 7- Identify critical points from Voronoi vertices.

  • evaluate if they are inside the bounding polygon and outside obstacles.

  • set features: [free], [in_bd_poly].
